name: actionPromptTimeMs
meaning: g_gameTimeMs when the prompt text was last rebuilt (500 ms refresh)

name: padBits
meaning: 0x1 jump, 0x8 run held, 0x10 sneak, 0x20 jump edge, 0x40 action, 0x80, 0x2 (swim)

name: bounceNormal
meaning: last wall/floor contact normal used for rocket bounce

name: bounceSpeed
meaning: extra speed along bounceNormal, decays with rec accel; zeroed by all ground steps

name: riders
meaning: objects attached to/riding the controllable; receive msg 0x6A

name: riderCount
meaning: count for riders[]; also gates platform-motion query

name: idleLoopCount
meaning: loops left before next idle variant (RNG)
